legacy_cells.B: Computational whole-body-exposome models for global precision brain health
legacy_cells.C: Agustín M. Ibáñez, Claudia A. Duran-Aniotz, Joaquín Migeot, Sandra Báez, Sol Fittipaldi, Carlos Coronel‐Oliveros, et al.
legacy_cells.I: 024_2025_Computational whole-body-exposome models for global precision brain health.pdf
legacy_cells.FM: Proposes a heuristic framework for integrating global multimodal data and theoretical models to address precision brain-health research challenges.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors note that longitudinal individual-level whole-body multi-omics modeling remains immature, particularly for underrepresented populations.
legacy_cells.FP: Develop ecological, deeply phenotyped, longitudinal brain-health models and human digital twins integrating whole-body measures, environmental exposures, and temporal monitoring.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify fragmented research, limited cohorts, and poorly integrated whole-body, exposome, and brain-health data as a gap.
legacy_cells.FR: The article proposes a framework and future agenda; it does not demonstrate an instantiated model, temporal transition, forecast, action comparison, or clinical utility.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M9 Safety & governance; M10 Clinician interface & lifecycle
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Carry the paper’s governance and evaluation considerations into a separate safety/lifecycle service; they do not validate a dynamics model.
legacy_cells.FU: Reviewer mapping (KB §20): Prospective evaluation & lifecycle governance
legacy_cells.FX: Title/byline (PDF pp. 1–2); abstract (p. 5); introduction and brain-health/framework discussion (pp. 6–10, 14–20); conclusions and future agenda (pp. 27–29); limitations discussion (p. 16); Tables 1–3 (pp. 55–57); peer-review and publication information (p. 59). The article is a perspective and contains no discrete empirical Methods or Results section. The table/figure layout is partly column-broken in extracted text, but no selected value depends on its tabular alignment. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: No implemented world model or paper-specific empirical evaluation is presented; the paper is a perspective proposing a heuristic framework and future agenda. A:I were left untouched. Extracted table/figure layout is partially garbled; this did not affect the supported classifications or quoted evidence. Evidence QA: 3/11 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (27.3%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 9 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 2 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Accepted unedited ArticleinPress version; content/pagination may differ from final edited version.
Conceptual heuristic perspective,not new model implementation/evaluation.
Cited cohorts,models and intervention outcomes are secondary examples,not own validation.
Fig2d prototypical implementation is future illustrative intervention concept; no gene therapy or multimodal composition evaluated.
Proxy associations and complex causal/ecological rhetoric do not establish identified treatment effects.
No new data/code/weights or independent human entailment review.
